title: chiara-speech2text_schema-folders
description: Schema to keep track of folder properties and cached review statistics in folders.json

is_processed.description: True if the folder is fully reviewed by a reviewer

n_audios.description: Number of audios in the folder

n_audios_reviewed.description: Number of audios marked reviewer_is_reviewed in the folder

audios_duration.description: Total duration of the audios in the folder in seconds

%_validated.description: Percentage of user-validated transcripts wrt total number

stats_computed.description: True when folder statistics, including reviewed-audio count, have been computed and cached

last_synced_at.description: UTC timestamp for the latest full Curate statistics sync

_metadata.description: Marks the sync timestamp record when folders.json has no folder records
